strings.CLD_Jupiter_Reaction_desc:
In the cornerstones of Bolívar's grand vision, we find the bedrock of our own struggle. The tragic downfall of Laureano Gómez and Roberto Urdaneta left our movement adrift, orphaned of its guiding hands.

Yet, despair has no claim upon us, for out of these darkened times, we have been graced with a new caudillo to lead us forward. Alfonso Uribe Misas, Governor of Antioquia, has risen from the ashes of our once-great party, rallying us to stand tall and fight for the noble cause championed by the leaders of old.
strings.CLD_Heldanomics_desc:
Under the steady guidance of our German allies in the diaspora—those who have generously shared their technical prowess and dedicated their expertise to the cause of renewal—we stride boldly forward.

Our foremost ambition is clear: to reshape our economy and embark upon audacious industrial ventures that will transform this untamed and resplendent land, a realm we hold in fierce and proud defense.
strings.CLD_Last_Knights_Old_Republic: The Last Knights of the Old Republic
strings.CLD_Last_Knights_Old_Republic_desc:
Colombia, the great Bolivarian republic, lies in its death throes, betrayed by its supposed protectors and consumed by dissent, estranged from God and tradition. It bleeds before our very eyes—a wound that has festered for far too long.

In its darkest all, when no one else answered its anguished call, a small band of veterans from the Leticia War—Villamizar, Gil, Bonitto, and Boy—rose to its defense. Joined by their trusted companions, they forged what we now hail as the Second Patriotic Army: the pride of our cause, the vanguard of restoration, and the final hope for the Old Republic.
strings.CLD_Birthplace_Old_Republic_desc:
The North—Cartagena, Barranquilla, Mompox—a gilded fragment of Colombia's storied past. This was not only the first land graced by the Spaniards' arrival but also the refuge where the union of free peoples, destined to shape Colombia, found sanctuary. While other regions clung to the crown or descended into turmoil, the North stood as a bastion of resilience.

It is a poetic turn of fate that we, the sworn defenders of this time-honored order, find our strongest allies here. Amidst the sweltering heat and misty marshlands, the North beats as the heart of Colombia—and the pulse of our cause. Just as it did 160 years ago.
strings.CLD_German_Support_dynmod_desc:
The Second Patriotic Army is joined in its anti-communist crusade by a coalition of nations from the heartland of Europe. Iberia, France, and Germany, all offer military training and experienced advisors that will offer an edge on the battlefield.

The fact this aid further ties the state to the Pakt and strengthens the already notable Germanophilia present in the PCC is a mere benign consequence.
